svg.title: After: Agent Manifest, a sandbox, and TRACE
svg.desc: Architecture of the target design for running unattended AI agents: a job manifest, one per job, renders the sandbox and the agent's settings before each run, and its profile hash goes into the TRACE record; outside the sandbox, a runner started by launchd starts a job script, which calls a wrapper gate that runs an integrity check, a credential refresh with an expiry guard, a startup canary, the agent and a connected-server check; the agent runs inside a kernel sandbox derived from its manifest, from one fixed, code-signed path, and writes its digest to a staging directory; an egress proxy on the sandbox wall passes only Anthropic runtime hosts and the manifest's tool hosts; secret files (keys, credential files, the signing key) and the raw mail replica are denied at the wall; the job script, not the agent, moves the digest into the notes vault; and the runner emits one signed TRACE record per session.
svg.text: A manifest, a sandbox, and TRACE
Deterministic code runs outside; the agent runs sandboxed at one fixed path.
moves the digest in on success
signed per session · key kept outside
one per job · tools · hosts · files
one OS consent, kept across updates
tool egress becomes the proxy allowlist;
filesystem scope is the field I propose
